'''1999 Tatooine Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Albuquerque, New Mexico in September 1999. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d54">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-tatooine-regional-w-rantd54/ tatooine-regional-w-rant], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 27 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-27-tatooine-regional-w-rantd54/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 1999
* '''Site:''' Albuquerque, New Mexico
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Qualified for Worlds:''' [[Thaddeus Chenoweth]] (Decipher's 1999 finalists list)<ref name="field99">[https://web.archive.org/web/19991128125001/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/swworldchamp/finalists.html Finalists], Decipher (Wayback 28 November 1999)</ref>
